summary: Independent review found five high-severity correctness and safety blockers in recovery checks, gate composition, storage ownership, and image immutability; route back to CODE.
validation: helm lint and default Helm renders: passed for both charts.
Argo inline-value gate-off renders: no forbidden target kinds; mismatch render proved nested workload gate can bypass wrapper gate.
Enabled backup render: checksum files reference the pre-rename .partial pathname.
Enabled LLM backup render: graph claim is llm-proxy-graph-artifacts with no PVC in the llm-proxy chart.
git diff --check f039009..HEAD: passed; protected worker/bridge/historical paths unchanged.
Current pipeline CI before report submission: passed with no warnings or errors.
blockers: Recovery verification cannot validate generated dumps because both backup templates checksum the temporary .partial pathname before renaming it.
The wrapper targetGates.workloads=false does not fence dependency API/web resources when llm-proxy.targetGates.workloads=true; network policy and wrapper safety resources can remain off.
LLM Proxy backup mounts a namespace-local graph PVC that is not created; Workspace Context creates a differently named PVC in another namespace.
Backup and restore resources can render without the corresponding database gate/resource, leaving invalid DB and secret references.
Workload and backup image checks accept non-empty mutable tags/refs and use IfNotPresent; immutable image identity is not enforced.
next_action: Route to CODE to fix all blockers, add effective mismatch/gate and executable checksum/storage tests, then rerun review checks; do not sync, deploy, restore, or approve a transition.
independent_lanes: Review full f039009..f8bef3f diff against the canonical feature spec.
Recheck effective Helm renders, recovery tooling, gates, RBAC, network policy, immutability, and protected paths.

issues.title: Generated dump checksums retain the temporary pathname
issues.details: In llm-proxy/templates/database-backup.yaml:107-113 and workspace-context/templates/backup.yaml:64-71, sha256sum writes a line for the .dump.partial file and that file is then renamed to .dump. llm-proxy/templates/restore.yaml:46 and workspace-context/templates/gated.yaml:51-53 verify the renamed file, so every generated restore check fails. Hash the final path/basename or rewrite the checksum after the rename, and execute the rendered shell contract in tests.

issues.title: Nested dependency workload gate bypasses the wrapper safety gate
issues.details: The dependency templates llm-proxy/vendor/llm-proxy/templates/deployment-api.yaml:1, deployment-web.yaml:1, and services.yaml:1 use .Values.targetGates.workloads from the nested llm-proxy values. A render with outer targetGates.workloads=false and nested llm-proxy.targetGates.workloads=true emits API/web Services and Deployments, while wrapper policies/alerts guarded by llm-proxy/templates/alerts.yaml:2 and homelab-egress-compatibility.yaml:2 remain off. Use one authoritative gate or fail on mismatch, and test both mismatch directions.

issues.title: LLM backup graph-artifact claim is not a valid target mount
issues.details: llm-proxy/templates/database-backup.yaml:176-185 mounts $backup.graphArtifacts.claimName, defaulting to llm-proxy-graph-artifacts, but no PVC with that name is created by llm-proxy; workspace-context creates workspace-context-graph-artifacts in its own namespace (workspace-context/templates/storage.yaml:17-49). PVCs are namespace-scoped, so the enabled backup cannot start. Create/own the claim in llm-proxy or run the coupled backup in the owning namespace with an explicit contract.

issues.title: Backup and restore jobs do not require the database gate
issues.details: workspace-context/templates/backup.yaml:1-6 gates only backup/storage and llm-proxy/templates/database-backup.yaml:1-9 gates only databaseBackup/consistency inputs; neither requires its database resource gate. The restore paths likewise validate restore flags but not database enablement (llm-proxy/templates/restore.yaml:1-5; workspace-context/templates/gated.yaml:16-20). Enabled renders can therefore emit jobs referencing a DB/Secret that is not deployed. Require the database gate and corresponding DB/storage readiness in every backup/restore condition.

issues.title: Image gates accept mutable references
issues.details: llm-proxy/templates/target-gates.yaml:3-8 only checks that workload repository/tag fields are non-empty, and backup images are only checked for non-empty values at llm-proxy/templates/database-backup.yaml:6 and workspace-context/templates/backup.yaml:5. The rendered workloads and backup containers use IfNotPresent and tag-based refs. Require digest-pinned refs (or a strictly validated immutable ref policy) for every enabled workload, restore, migration, pg_dump, and Kopia image, and test rejection of latest/mutable tags.
